summary: UIE Plc invests in the agro-industrial, and industrial and technology sectors in Malaysia, Indonesia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Plantations; Refining; and Other segments. It engages in the cultivation of oil palm and coconuts, and processing of palm oil into palm fractions for the specialty fats and chocolate industry. The company was formerly known as United International Enterprises Limited and changed its name to UIE Plc in October 2020. UIE Plc was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Ta' Xbiex, Malta. UIE Plc is a subsidiary of Brothers Holding Limited.
